## 26 · Fee Reminder
For gyms, tuition classes, schools, subscriptions, rent or any monthly fee. **2 days before**, on the due date, and **7 and 15 days after**: a polite WhatsApp with a UPI pay link (amount already filled in). No awkward follow-up calls.

**Setup (10 min)**
1. Google Sheets nodes: add a **Google Sheets OAuth2** credential and paste your sheet link in place of YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_URL. Tab **Dues**: Customer, Phone, For, Amount, Due date (yyyy-mm-dd), Status (unpaid/paid), Reminders.
2. WhatsApp nodes: add a **WhatsApp Business Cloud API** credential and replace YOUR_PHONE_NUMBER_ID with your Phone Number ID (Meta → WhatsApp → API setup).
3. Replace YOUR_UPI_ID and YOUR%20BUSINESS%20NAME in the **Reminder due?** code node.

Mark Status = paid when the money arrives. No AI: fixed, polite text.
